Bocki Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Boćki, Poland

Not demolished. Boćki's original Jewish cemetery (see the Boćki New Jewish Cemetery record for the town's fuller community history), likely established in the first half of the 17th century near a reform monastery complex built after 1730, was enclosed with a low concrete wall in the 1930s. Abandoned after WWII, two apartment blocks were built over most of the site in the 1960s-70s; some granite matzevot (with inscriptions dated 1801-1874) were removed during this period and repurposed to build a fence for the town's Christian cemetery.
